_doc: Home screen with the panel PMIC never answering (--i2c-faults 1.0:pmic): every refresh must fail after the board driver's retries (ok = false, nothing driven), and no waveform may start without rails.

display.power_failures.why: the failed power-ups must be reported as failed updates

display.unpowered_waveforms.why: no waveform without good rails and VCOM

panic.count.why: the system must survive a dead panel supply
